scope: PRF-06 packed public distribution, baseline/Task feature-cost diagnostics; no release or optional-provider qualification
cacheScope: cold means new incognito context HTTP cache, not a new OS/browser process; warm means same-context HTTP cache and acknowledged IndexedDB restore
timingScope: navigation to SDK ready/first frame/accepted public command; CDP best-effort executed-script coverage observations, without Debugger enablement or precise-coverage instrumentation; harness overhead included; no compositor or trusted-input claim
limitsSource: benchmarks/config.json and architecture/specs/verification.md; preserved diagnostic targets, never raised
coverageMethod: Profiler.getBestEffortCoverage after public edit; executed-script identities plus packed static graph and observed executed function ranges; no per-function exact call counts
warmupPolicy: none; every cold sample starts a fresh context, then exactly one acknowledged same-context warm restore
sampleOrder: Task baseline, Task task, Long baseline, Long task; paired cold then warm
samplingDecision: 12 fixed pairs per combination within bounded source session; 100 minimum tail samples remains unchanged, tails inconclusive; earlier 100-pair attempts retained as interrupted evidence
phaseScope: Contiguous navigation-clock intervals, including checkpoint fetch/decode/publish, editor construction/recovery+surface, double RAF, independent oracle reads/projection/hashes, public anchors/commit/release, exact restoration and flush. No oracle subtraction from navigation-to-first-accepted-edit. Resource timings observe transfer/cache; WASM compilation/instantiation and recovery/surface subphases remain combined.
